caveats: individualTaxYear runs 1 April to 31 March (grade I, from the Cook Islands assessment cycle; the MFEM page confirms the value added tax year but not the individual year directly).
companyYearEndDefault is a 31 March app default for new entities (grade I), matching the tax year.
The 15% rate has applied since 1 April 2014 (VAT Act s.11 as amended by No. 1 of 2014).
